items.title: Thomas Andrew Dorsey Interview, 1980-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You mean Joe May or Cleopas? [INTERVIEWEE] Either one of the hands.

ctx.x: Mahalia not only, she worked in everything, just the church, the lodge, wherever they wanted her to sing, and she sang her gospel songs, she was easy to get. And she loved to do it. Now the boy you just mentioned there, he's good, but he didn't get around as much as Mahalia.
You mean Joe May or Cleopas?
